result.interpretation: The global pair count passes but coverage fails. Do not fit or lower the threshold. Audit fixed-goal contrast before collecting fresh clean-gated data.

research_question: Can an uncertainty-aware comparison reward learned from repeated four-cell AgentDojo outcomes select utility-preserving successful attacks on held-out tasks better than an equal-capacity absolute four-cell predictor?

evidence_basis.motivation: The v34 absolute selector tied the structured baseline, lost to random expectation, and had sparse within-task signal. Recent automated prompt-injection work uses comparison feedback to densify binary rewards; v35 tests that mechanism without new attack execution.

forbidden_inputs: raw payload and injection goal text

comparison_target.posterior: independent Dirichlet posterior over n00,n01,n10,n11 with alpha=0.5
comparison_target.interpretation: joint success dominates; attack success without user-task utility is penalized; benign utility is only a small tie-breaker
comparison_target.pair_label: posterior probability that the left candidate has larger constrained reward

data_support_gate.failure_policy: Stop before model fitting and authorize only a separately preregistered high-contrast strategy-generation pilot.

model.baseline: equal-capacity structured pre-execution encoder trained by task-balanced four-cell cross-entropy
model.candidate: structured pre-execution encoder with a scalar Bradley-Terry comparison head and an auxiliary four-cell outcome anchor
model.diagnostic: candidate with attack family/name/variant features to test whether a family shortcut is required

decision_policy.go: Authorize one fixed-budget AgentDojo-sandbox high-contrast candidate-generation pilot using comparison feedback and a frozen transferable strategy library; do not authorize a large world model.
decision_policy.no_go_support: The existing 400 configurations do not contain enough preference support. Skip further selector fitting and build a high-contrast strategy-generation pilot.
decision_policy.no_go_policy: Comparison learning does not generalize task-disjointly. Retain the data audit and pivot to iterative strategy-library search with empirical sandbox feedback rather than a larger predictor.
